Implementation notes

Independent strong review confirmed a rare aggregate mismatch: each retained resolution accepts up to 128 dependency paths, while one observation is limited to 4096 distinct paths.33 lens-discovered rejections with125 disjoint paths can be accepted in three batches of11 when absent from the risk plan (1375 observed paths per batch). A later delta assessment can carry all33 identities, making the next ordinary advance collect4125 paths and fail before processing.

Preserve bounded I/O, immutable finding/resolution history, legitimate reopening requirements and the three-clean-round floor. Reconcile producer/consumer limits and provide supported handling for previously retained histories; do not silently prune evidence or raise resource limits without justification. Validate with a reachable public RPC lifecycle and invalid/over-budget refusal cases.

Evidence: /tmp/resolution-observation-fix/aggregate-verifier-result.json; source commit78d168f9687d25be906dc72d2624963957fc6adc. Existing consumer cap remains unchanged in the scoped carried-observation fix; no current Foundry4130-path failure was observed.

Admission comparison: materially distinct resource-policy/large-history edge. Frequency unlikely, no security/human harm, bounded large-review blocking, independently confirmed static evidence, moderate leverage, resource/compatibility design required. Lower priority than all current ordinary-workflow blockers; preserve their order and place this item last. Current implementation scope is not expanded.
event_data.summary: Large reviews can become stuck after collecting many independent rejections. Keep accepted review records compatible with the amount of source evidence a later step can safely read, so review progress remains possible without removing resource limits.
event_data.title: Keep large reviews moving safely
